info.title: API.SH: Yelp
info.description: The Yelp API from API.SH: public Yelp data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
Full business details: rating, review count, price, categories, phone, website, menu link, address, neighborhoods, coordinates, opening hours, amenities and attributes, review highlights, summary, photos, claimed status and health inspections where Yelp shows them.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/yelp-business

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Business alias (as in yelp.com/biz/<alias>) or the 22-character business id. Give `id` or `url`.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Business page URL (instead of `id`).

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: Extra sections, comma-separated: `rating_distribution` (review count per star, 1-5) and `popular_dishes` (the menu's dishes with reviews or photos; empty when the business has no menu on Yelp).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: Yelp business menu (dishes and popular dishes)
get.description:
A business's menu on Yelp: sections with each dish's name, description, price (text and number, plus size/option prices when the menu lists several), the number of reviews and photos that mention it, its photo and Yelp link. `popular_dishes` ranks the dishes by those review and photo counts (top 10). Restaurants with several menus list them in `other_menus`; pass a menu's last path segment as `menu`. Businesses without a menu on Yelp answer 404.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/yelp-menu

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Business alias (the part after /biz/ or /menu/ in a Yelp link) or Yelp business id.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A yelp.com/biz/ or /menu/ link, instead of `id`.

parameters.name: menu
parameters.description: A sub-menu name from `other_menus` (e.g. `dinner`, `brunch`); default the main menu.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Pass `next_page` from the previous response; `next_page` is null on the last page.

Businesses for a search and location (10 per page, sponsored results flagged with `sponsored`): id, alias, name, url, rating, review count, price, categories, address, phone, neighborhoods, coordinates, photo, hours and closed flag. Yelp shows at most 240 results (24 pages) per search. Optional feature filters (delivery, takeout, reservations, outdoor seating, wheelchair access, good for kids and more), category, open now, and a radius around a point; `applied_filters` echoes them and `available_filters` lists every filter Yelp offers for this search (type, value, label, selected), whose `features` values can be passed back.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/yelp-search

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: What to look for (category, cuisine or business name).

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: City, neighborhood, address or ZIP code.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: recommended (default), rating or review_count.

parameters.name: price
parameters.description: Price levels 1-4, comma separated (1 = $, 4 = $$$$).

parameters.name: features
parameters.description: Feature filters, comma separated (all must match): delivery, takeout, reservations, waitlist, outdoor_seating, wheelchair, good_for_kids, dogs_allowed, free_wifi, open_24h, full_bar, happy_hour, has_tv, good_for_groups, good_for_dinner, good_for_lunch, good_for_breakfast, good_for_brunch, street_parking, garage_parking, valet_parking, apple_pay, gender_neutral_restrooms, or a `features` value from `available_filters`.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Yelp category alias (e.g. pizza, thai, italian, coffee), up to 5 comma separated; see `available_filters` entries of type category.

parameters.name: open_now
parameters.description: true: only businesses open now.

parameters.name: lat
parameters.description: Latitude of a point to search around (with lon); the results are limited to the area around it.

parameters.name: lon
parameters.description: Longitude of that point (with lat).

parameters.name: radius_km
parameters.description: Distance from lat/lon in km, 0.1-40 (default 1.6).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Pass `next_page` from the previous response; `next_page` is null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
